name: EventBus
purpose: In-process publish/subscribe point for named framework and application events (e.g. sql.active_record, http.request) with structured payloads.
api_signature:
from typing import Any, Callable, Mapping, Protocol

Subscriber = Callable[[str, Mapping[str, Any]], None]

class EventBus(Protocol):
    def publish(self, name: str, payload: Mapping[str, Any]) -> None: ...
    def subscribe(self, pattern: str, handler: Subscriber) -> Callable[[], None]: ...
invariants: publish() MUST deliver to every matching subscriber synchronously OR through a declared executor; delivery order per subscriber SHALL be the subscription order.
A subscriber that raises MUST NOT abort delivery to other subscribers; the error SHALL be reported to the observability sink.
The returned unsubscribe callable MUST be idempotent; calling it twice CANNOT remove a different subscription.
Event names MUST follow a dotted namespace (e.g. 'sql.active_record'); wildcards SHALL use a documented pattern syntax.
Payloads MUST be treated as immutable by subscribers; mutating a payload to signal another subscriber is FORBIDDEN.
extension_contract: Downstream tools publish named events via publish() and consumers subscribe via subscribe()/an @EventListener-style decorator; tracing/metrics plug in as a provider that subscribes to patterns (e.g. '*.active_record') without touching producers.
consumption_example:
def on_sql(name: str, payload: dict) -> None:
    duration = payload.get('duration', 0)
    _ = (name, duration)

bus: EventBus
unsub = bus.subscribe('sql.*', on_sql)
bus.publish('sql.query', {'duration': 12})
unsub()
why_essential: Observability code (tracing, audit, metrics) MUST attach to framework internals without forking the framework; a bus turns 'I need to know when X happens' into a subscription instead of a patch.
alternatives_considered: AOP/monkey-patching around framework methods — fragile and invisible
Dedicated callbacks per concern — combinatorial wiring
External broker for in-process events — overkill latency and ops burden
